A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GeoClip research. Their text, equations, algorithms, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support comparison, including v2 Appendices A–D and v3 Appendices A–E.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic, tabular, image fine-tuning, and low-rank classification experiments in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds full-covariance versus low-rank comparisons and USPS hyperparameter ablations in Appendices D–E.

M1.justification: The full-covariance and low-rank procedures remain unchanged. Algorithm 2's revised indexing and centering on the updated mean match the streaming PCA routine already present in v2 Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic regression/classification tasks, Diabetes, Breast Cancer, Android Malware, MNIST-to-Fashion-MNIST transfer, and USPS. The added analyses reuse existing synthetic and USPS coverage.

E2.justification: v3 Figure 3 adds full-covariance GeoClip as a comparator to rank-50 GeoClip on the 400-feature synthetic task. AdaClip, DP-SGD, and quantile-based clipping remain the external baselines.

E3.justification: v3 adds a full-covariance control and USPS sweeps that vary gamma, h1, and h2 individually. Tables 5–7 specify rank 50, although their 'same settings' reference points to Section 4.4's rank-100 USPS experiment. The retained benchmark splits, metrics, and training budgets are unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendices D–E introduce direct validation of low-rank approximation against full covariance and three hyperparameter sensitivity studies. These substantially expand component and robustness analysis beyond v2's benchmark comparisons and qualitative robustness assertions.

E5.justification: Existing 20-seed and five-seed reporting with standard deviations is retained. The new ablation Tables 5–7 instead present point accuracies without uncertainty estimates or explicit run counts. No increase in repetitions or new statistical test is documented.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 are unchanged. Figure 2's synthetic GeoClip mean and deviation band are revised, with the last plotted mean approximately 89.6% in v2 versus 89.5% in v3; baseline values and the leading ranking remain unchanged. New results show comparable full/low-rank accuracy and USPS sensitivities, including 85.537–86.182% across gamma settings.

T1.justification: Theorems 1–2, their assumptions, optimization arguments, and Appendix A–B proofs are unchanged. Norm notation and PCA indexing are refined; omitted duplicate Appendix C equations have equivalent counterparts in Section 3.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometry-aware clipping, adaptation without additional privacy cost, convergence guarantees, optimal transformations, improved utility, and low-rank scalability.

C2.justification: v3 argues that faster convergence partly offsets computational and memory overhead. It also adds explicit limitations concerning eigendecomposition costs, additional hyperparameter tuning, and limited dataset coverage.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly specifies Gaussian feature construction, weight and bias distributions, and target-noise standard deviation 0.01; Section 4.4 links its construction to this description. v3 also provides a GeoClip implementation reference. These are documentation additions, without evidence that existing data-generation procedures changed.

R1.justification: The bibliography adds one citation to the GeoClip implementation, numbered 16 in v3. Earlier research citations, novelty framing, and positioning relative to previous methods remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 expands localized explanations, makes appendix references explicit, standardizes PCA notation, and removes redundant Appendix C exposition. Limitations, broader-impact, and acknowledgements paragraphs are added, while most prose and the main section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 removes v2's duplicate accuracy Figure 3 and combines the old Figure 4 privacy plots with a new comparison panel in Figure 3. It adds Tables 5–7, redraws Figure 2's synthetic panel, and adjusts spacing and table placement within the existing layout.

improvement.justification: v3 strengthens support for the low-rank approximation, adds sensitivity evidence, improves synthetic-data documentation and code-access information, and states concrete limitations. These are useful, bounded gains. The unexplained synthetic-curve revision and Appendix E's rank inconsistency and missing uncertainty limit the added evidence, while the core method, proofs, and principal benchmark tables remain stable.
